description: Application for a new Mayor's Permit and business license to operate a commercial, trading, or industrial establishment within Roxas City via the Business One-Stop Shop (BOSS).
steps: Submit Unified Business Application Form at the Business Permits & Licensing Office (BPLO), City Hall Compound.
Receive automated one-stop assessment from City Engineering, City Health, CENRO, and BFP.
Pay corresponding business taxes, regulatory fees, and fire inspection fee at the City Treasury cashier.
Claim Mayor's Business Permit and official Business Plate.
requirements: DTI Business Name Registration (Sole Proprietorship) or SEC Certificate of Registration (Corporation/Partnership)
Barangay Business Clearance from the barangay where business is situated
Contract of Lease (if renting) or Land Title / Tax Declaration (if owned)
Zoning & Locational Clearance from City Planning Office
Sanitary Permit from City Health Office
Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (FSIC) from BFP Roxas City

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Entrepreneurs and corporate entities operating in Roxas City

sources.name: Roxas City Business Permits and Licensing Office (BPLO)
Republic Act No. 11032 (Ease of Doing Business Act)

description: Annual renewal of Mayor's Permit for active commercial establishments operating in Roxas City, processed every January with early-payment incentives.
steps: Submit previous year's Mayor's Permit and certified Gross Receipts / Income Tax Return.
Secure clearances from City Health, CENRO, and Bureau of Fire Protection at the BOSS Center.
Pay business license taxes and regulatory fees at the City Treasurer's Office.
Receive renewed Mayor's Permit and current year registration sticker.
requirements: Previous Year Mayor's Permit and Official Receipts
Audited Financial Statement or Sworn Statement of Gross Receipts
Current Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (BFP Roxas City)

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Existing business owners in Roxas City
quickInfo.fee: Based on gross sales tax brackets
